description: This Java class extends the JMeter SampleResult class to add support for tracking error counts specifically for the HonoCommanderSampler, enabling error count visibility in reports.

classes.name: HonoCommanderSampleResult
classes.description: A subclass of SampleResult that adds the ability to set and retrieve an error count for the HonoCommanderSampler.

methods.name: getErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the current error count for the sample result.

methods.name: setErrorCount
methods.description: Sets the error count for the sample result, overriding the default behavior to enable custom error tracking.
